name: broadbanner-scheduled-tasks
description: The scheduled-task engine for BroadBanner Cowork projects. The `manage` skill installs, updates, or uninstalls declarative scheduled-task specs (cron or one-time) in the Cowork scheduler from a project's .broadbanner/scheduled-tasks/ directory, filed under the project it's run from. Generic and reusable — tier plugins supply their own task templates via --templates-dir. Renamed from broadbanner-scheduling.
